manifest.title: 英语时态与主谓一致综合专项训练
manifest.subject: english

knowledgePoints.title: 一般现在时
knowledgePoints.content: 表示经常性、习惯性动作或客观事实。主语为第三人称单数时，谓语动词加 -s/-es；其他主语用动词原形。

knowledgePoints.title: 一般过去时
knowledgePoints.content: 表示过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态。规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词需单独记忆。否定用 didn't + 动词原形。

knowledgePoints.title: 现在进行时
knowledgePoints.content: 表示此刻或现阶段正在进行的动作。结构：be (am/is/are) + doing。常与 now, look, listen 连用。

knowledgePoints.title: 主谓一致（单三与非单三）
knowledgePoints.content: 一般现在时中，主语为 he/she/it/单数名词时，动词用单三形式；主语为 I/you/we/they/复数名词时，动词用原形。

knowledgePoints.title: 一般疑问句
knowledgePoints.content: 将 be 动词、情态动词或助动词 do/does/did 提到主语前。回答用 Yes/No。

knowledgePoints.title: 特殊疑问句
knowledgePoints.content: 特殊疑问词（what/who/where/when/why/how 等）+ 一般疑问句语序。不能用 Yes/No 回答。

knowledgePoints.title: 定语从句
knowledgePoints.content: 修饰名词或代词的从句，紧跟先行词。先行词指人用 who/that；指物用 which/that。从句谓语与先行词保持一致。

units.name: 综合专项训练
units.title: 英语时态与主谓一致综合专项训练
units.desc: 四种能力叠加训练：时态、主谓一致、疑问句、定语从句。每题至少融合两项。

exercises.question: My brother ______ to school by bike every day.
exercises.explanation: 主语 My brother 是第三人称单数，every day 提示一般现在时，动词加 -es。故选 B。

exercises.question: Look! The children ______ in the playground now.
exercises.explanation: Look 和 now 提示现在进行时，主语是复数用 are playing。故选 C。

exercises.question: ______ your sister like music?
exercises.explanation: 主语 your sister 为第三人称单数，一般现在时一般疑问句用 Does，后接动词原形。故选 B。

exercises.question: The girl ______ is wearing a red skirt is my cousin.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 girl 指人，用 who 引导定语从句，从句用现在进行时。故选 B。

exercises.question: They ______ football every Sunday afternoon.
exercises.explanation: 主语 They 是非单三，every Sunday afternoon 提示一般现在时，动词用原形。故选 A。

exercises.question: —What ______ you doing now? —I ______ reading a book.
exercises.explanation: now 提示现在进行时；第一空 you 用 are；第二空 I 用 am。故选 A。

exercises.question: My father ______ TV last night.
exercises.explanation: last night 提示一般过去时，watch 的过去式是 watched。故选 C。

exercises.question: —______ does your mother go to work? —By bus.
exercises.explanation: By bus 回答交通方式，用 How 提问。故选 B。

exercises.question: The book ______ is on the desk is mine.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 book 指物，用 which 引导定语从句。故选 C。

exercises.question: ______ she ______ her homework now?
exercises.explanation: now 提示现在进行时，一般疑问句把 is 提前，动词用 doing。故选 A。

exercises.question: He often ______ to music after school.
exercises.explanation: often 提示一般现在时，He 是第三人称单数，动词加 -s。故选 B。

exercises.question: We ______ to the zoo last Sunday.
exercises.explanation: last Sunday 提示一般过去时，go 的过去式是 went。故选 C。

exercises.question: ______ your parents ______ English?
exercises.explanation: 主语 parents 是复数，用 Do，后接动词原形 speak。故选 A。

exercises.question: The man ______ is talking to my father is a doctor.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 man 指人，用 who 引导定语从句，从句用现在进行时。故选 C。

exercises.question: She go to school every day.
exercises.explanation: She 是第三人称单数，go 应改为 goes。故本题错误。

exercises.question: They are playing basketball now.
exercises.explanation: 主语复数 + are + doing，符合现在进行时结构。故本题正确。

exercises.question: Does he likes English?
exercises.explanation: Does 后动词必须用原形，likes 应改为 like。故本题错误。

exercises.question: The girl who is singing is my sister.
exercises.explanation: who 引导定语从句，先行词指人，从句是现在进行时，结构正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: What time do she get up?
exercises.explanation: she 是第三人称单数，助动词应用 does，应为 What time does she get up?。故本题错误。

exercises.question: My mother is cook in the kitchen now.
exercises.explanation: is 后应接现在分词 cooking。故本题错误。

exercises.question: I watched TV with my family yesterday evening.
exercises.explanation: yesterday evening 提示一般过去时，watched 形式正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: The book which I bought yesterday is very interesting.
exercises.explanation: which 指物，从句用过去时 bought，主句用现在时 is，结构正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: Do your brother like playing football?
exercises.explanation: brother 是第三人称单数，应用 Does。故本题错误。

exercises.question: Listen! The birds are singing in the tree.
exercises.explanation: Listen 提示现在进行时，are singing 形式正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: She ______ (go) to school at 7:00 every morning.
exercises.explanation: She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -es，故填 goes。

exercises.question: Look! They ______ (play) football on the playground.
exercises.explanation: Look 提示现在进行时，复数主语用 are playing。

exercises.question: My sister ______ (not like) watching TV.
exercises.explanation: 单三否定用 doesn't + 动词原形，故填 doesn't like。

exercises.question: ______ (be) you at home yesterday?
exercises.explanation: you 在过去时中用 were，疑问句将 Were 提前，首字母大写。

exercises.question: He ______ (do) his homework now.
exercises.explanation: now 提示现在进行时，He 是单三用 is doing。

exercises.question: The boy ______ (who) is running is my brother.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 boy 指人，用 who 引导定语从句。

exercises.question: —______ he ______ (have) a brother? —Yes, he does.
exercises.explanation: 单三一般疑问句用 Does 提前，动词用原形 have。

exercises.question: My parents ______ (be) both teachers.
exercises.explanation: parents 是复数，be 动词用 are。

exercises.question: Look! The girl who ______ an English song is my cousin.
exercises.explanation: Look 提示进行时，从句用 is singing。故选 B。

exercises.question: —______ your brother ______ to school yesterday? —No, he was ill.
exercises.explanation: yesterday 提示过去时，Did 后接动词原形 go。故选 A。

exercises.question: The dictionary ______ I bought last week ______ very useful.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 dictionary 指物用 which，单数用 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: Listen! Someone ______ the door.
exercises.explanation: Listen 提示进行时，someone 作单三用 is knocking。故选 C。

exercises.question: —What ______ your father usually ______ after dinner? —He usually takes a walk.
exercises.explanation: usually 提示一般现在时，单三助动词 does + 原形 do。故选 B。

exercises.question: The boy ______ is playing basketball ______ my cousin.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 boy 指人用 who，主句主语单三用 is。故选 A。

exercises.question: My mother often ______ me with my homework, but yesterday she ______ too tired.
exercises.explanation: often 现在时单三用 helps；yesterday 过去时用 was。故选 B。

exercises.question: —______ the students ______ an English class now? —Yes, they are.
exercises.explanation: now 提示进行时，复数主语用 Are; having。故选 A。

exercises.question: This is the most interesting book ______ I have ever read.
exercises.explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰，只能用 that。故选 D。

exercises.question: His sister ______ TV every evening, but now she ______ her homework.
exercises.explanation: every evening 用单三 watches；now 用 is doing。故选 B。

exercises.question: ______ they ______ to the beach last weekend?
exercises.explanation: last weekend 提示过去时，Did 后接原形 go。故选 A。

exercises.question: The woman ______ is talking to my mother ______ a nurse.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 woman 指人用 who；主句单三用 is。故选 A。

exercises.question: —______ do you usually go to the library? —Once a week.
exercises.explanation: Once a week 回答频率，用 How often。故选 A。

exercises.question: Look at the boy. He ______ a book under the tree. The book ______ about animals.
exercises.explanation: Look 提示进行时，主语 He 用 is reading；书单数用 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: The man ______ helped me yesterday ______ my uncle.
exercises.explanation: man 指人用 who；主句描述现状用现在时 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: My grandfather ______ a walk in the park every morning. He ______ very healthy.
exercises.explanation: every morning 一般现在时，grandfather 单三用 takes；He 单三用 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: —Who ______ the girl under the tree? —She is my sister.
exercises.explanation: Who + be 动词询问身份，girl 单数用 is。故选 A。

exercises.question: The film ______ we saw yesterday ______ very interesting.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 film 指物用 which；主句描述过去感受用 was。故选 C。

exercises.question: Does she goes to school by bus every day?
exercises.explanation: Does 后应为动词原形 go，不是 goes。故本题错误。

exercises.question: The boy who is playing the piano is my cousin.
exercises.explanation: who 引导定语从句，从句是现在进行时，结构正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: My father didn't watched TV last night.
exercises.explanation: didn't 后用动词原形 watch。故本题错误。

exercises.question: What is your mother do now?
exercises.explanation: now 提示进行时，应为 What is your mother doing now?。故本题错误。

exercises.question: The students are reading books in the library.
exercises.explanation: 复数主语 + are doing，符合现在进行时。故本题正确。

exercises.question: He is the man which helped me yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 man 指人，应用 who 或 that。故本题错误。

exercises.question: My sister often helps my mother with housework.
exercises.explanation: often 一般现在时，sister 单三用 helps，正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: Are she watching TV now?
exercises.explanation: she 是单三，应用 Is。故本题错误。

exercises.question: Look! The girl who ______ (wear) a red dress ______ (sing) on the stage.
exercises.explanation: Look 提示进行时；girl 单三用 is wearing 和 is singing。

exercises.question: My brother usually ______ (get) up at 6:30, but yesterday he ______ (get) up at 8:00.
exercises.explanation: usually 一般现在时单三用 gets；yesterday 一般过去时用 got。

exercises.question: —______ your father ______ (go) to work by car? —No, he doesn't. He ______ (walk) to work every day.
exercises.explanation: 单三一般疑问句用 Does + 原形 go；答句单三用 walks。

exercises.question: The book ______ (which) is on the table ______ (be) mine.
exercises.explanation: 先行词物用 which；book 单数用 is。

exercises.question: They ______ (play) basketball now. They ______ (play) it every Saturday.
exercises.explanation: now 进行时用 are playing；every Saturday 一般现在时用 play。

exercises.question: The man ______ (who) is standing there ______ (be) my English teacher.
exercises.explanation: 先行词人用 who；man 单数用 is。

exercises.question: The boy ______ is wearing glasses, ______ father is a doctor, ______ my best friend.
exercises.explanation: 第一空 who 作从句主语；第二空 whose 表所属；第三空主句单三用 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: —______ the girl who ______ a red skirt ______ to school every day? —Yes, she does.
exercises.explanation: 主句疑问用 Does 提前；定语从句 who 后单三 wears；主句动词原形 go。故选 A。

exercises.question: My parents, who ______ both teachers, ______ very busy every day.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 parents 复数，从句用 are；主句主语复数用 are。故选 C。

exercises.question: Listen! The girl who ______ an English song ______ my sister.
exercises.explanation: Listen 提示从句进行时 is singing；主句单三用 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: —What ______ the boy ______ now? —He ______ a book under the tree.
exercises.explanation: now 提示现在进行时；boy 单三用 is；答句 He 单三用 is reading。故选 A。

exercises.question: The woman ______ we met yesterday ______ us with our English.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 woman 指人用 who；主句描述现状用 helps。故选 A。

exercises.question: Does the man who ______ a black coat ______ English?
exercises.explanation: Does 后主句动词用原形 teach；定语从句 who 后单三 wears。故选 B。

exercises.question: My sister, who ______ in a hospital, ______ to work by bus every day.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 sister 单三，从句用 works；主句单三用 goes。故选 A。

exercises.question: This is the boy ______ helped me when I ______ in trouble.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 boy 指人用 who；when 从句描述过去用 was。故选 B。

exercises.question: —______ your brother ______ TV now? —No, he ______ his homework.
exercises.explanation: now 提示现在进行时；brother 单三用 Is；答句 He 单三用 is doing。故选 A。

exercises.question: The students who ______ playing football on the playground ______ from Class One.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 students 复数，从句用 are；主句主语复数用 are。故选 B。

exercises.question: Does the boy who is playing the piano like music?
exercises.explanation: Does 提前；定语从句 who is playing 正确；主句动词用原形 like。故本题正确。

exercises.question: The woman who is talking to my mother are my aunt.
exercises.explanation: 主句主语 The woman 是单数，应用 is。故本题错误。

exercises.question: What is the girl who is wearing a red dress doing now?
exercises.explanation: What ... doing 是进行时特殊疑问句；定语从句 who is wearing 正确。故本题正确。

exercises.question: My father, who is a teacher, often help me with my homework.
exercises.explanation: 主句主语 My father 是单三，应用 helps。故本题错误。

exercises.question: The girl who ______ (sing) an English song now ______ (be) my cousin. She ______ (like) English very much.
exercises.explanation: now 提示进行时，girl 单三用 is singing；主句单三用 is；like 单三加 -s 为 likes。
